components.css: .ds-product{max-width:390px;color:var(--ink,#153e44);font-family:var(--body,'DM Sans',sans-serif);}.ds-product h3{font:600 29px/1.1 var(--display,"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif);margin:0}.ds-detail{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#52656a);margin:7px 0 14px}.ds-product details{border-top:1px solid var(--line,#cecfc6);padding:11px 0;font-size:12px}.ds-product summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-weight:500}.ds-product summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-product summary svg{width:17px;height:17px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;transition:transform .3s}.ds-product details[open] summary svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-product summary:hover{color:var(--action,#b84214)}.ds-product summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--action,#b84214);outline-offset:5px}.ds-facts{padding-top:13px}.ds-facts p{font-size:13px;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--muted,#52656a)}.ds-facts strong{color:var(--ink,#153e44)}.ds-consult{margin-top:10px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 0;border-block:1px solid var(--line,#cecfc6);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;transition:color .2s}.ds-consult:hover{color:var(--action,#b84214)}.ds-consult:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--action,#b84214);outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-product summary svg,.ds-consult{transition:none}}.ds-consult svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6}

components.name: Comfort choice radio
components.description: Native checked, hover and keyboard state without JS.
components.css: .ds-choices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;color:var(--ink,#153e44);font-family:var(--body,'DM Sans',sans-serif);}.ds-choices label{cursor:pointer;position:relative}.ds-choices input{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0}.ds-choices span{display:block;padding:11px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cecfc6);font-size:13px;border-radius:4px;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s,color .3s,transform .3s}.ds-choices input:checked+span{background:var(--night,#062c34);border-color:var(--night,#062c34);color:var(--paper,#f6f2eb);transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-choices input:focus-visible+span{outline:3px solid var(--action,#b84214);outline-offset:3px}.ds-choices label:hover span{border-color:var(--ink,#153e44)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-choices span{transition:none}.ds-choices input:checked+span{transform:none}}

components.name: Search and native select
components.description: Actual bordered search and guide select; standalone browser controls.
components.css: .ds-fields{color:var(--ink,#153e44);font-family:var(--body,'DM Sans',sans-serif);}.ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line,#cecfc6);padding-right:12px;max-width:330px}.ds-search input{background:none;border:0;padding:10px 12px;width:280px;max-width:100%;min-width:0;font:400 12px/1.6 var(--body,"DM Sans",sans-serif);color:inherit;caret-color:var(--action,#b84214)}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#52656a);opacity:1}.ds-search svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6}.ds-label{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin:20px 0 10px}.ds-select{width:100%;background:var(--paper,#f6f2eb);border:1px solid var(--line,#cecfc6);padding:11px 14px;border-radius:4px;font:400 13px/1.6 var(--body,"DM Sans",sans-serif);color:inherit}.ds-search:hover,.ds-select:hover{border-color:var(--ink,#153e44)}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--action,#b84214);outline-offset:5px}.ds-select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--action,#b84214);outline-offset:5px}.ds-sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap}

narrative.northStar: A living showroom of the next morning
narrative.overview: V4 uses furnished rooms, compressed headlines and honest source-backed comparison. Warm paper and petrol organize shopping; orange carries emphasis and consultation. User-pinned Loja Castor reference and actual V4 code supersede rejected V3; no approved V4 comp or new QUALITY BAR exists.

rules.name: Two oranges
rules.body: Orange emphasizes dark headings; action carries white-text controls and focus.

rules.name: Complete static content
rules.body: Reduced motion and unavailable JS leave six catalog models, facts, native details and contact visible.

dos: Do preserve actual model/source identity and contact truth.
Do use current warm paper tokens.
Do keep keyboard focus and source disclosures.
donts: Do not restore rejected V3 composition or white cutouts.
Do not assert local stock, prices, hours or included accessories.
Do not claim temporal smoothness from still captures.
